request.style: English, male solo voice, warm and reverent, acoustic guitar, piano, cello, soft strings, gentle and solemn, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
From the line of Aaron’s house
Eleazar lived in holy trust
Phinehas burned with zeal for God
Abishua walked the sacred road

[Chorus]
Bukki, son of Abishua
Holding the priesthood through
Uzzi followed in his line
A holy order, divine

[Verse]
In Chronicles the names are kept
A chain of fathers, never slept
Zerahiah came after him
Carrying the sacred rim

[Chorus]
Bukki, son of Abishua
Holding the priesthood through
Uzzi followed in his line
A holy order, divine

[Bridge]
From Aaron down to Ezra’s day
The priestly line held steady sway
No break in the chain of faith
Keeping the covenant safe

[Outro]
Bukki, son of Abishua
A name in the holy book
The line of Aaron stands
Faithful to the Lord’s commands
